implementation.summary: Reuse per-draw Vulkan upload buffers across fence-safe in-flight slots.
implementation.mapping: Persistently mapped host-visible buffers; flush noncoherent ranges before submission.
implementation.lifetime: Frames hold non-owning references; cache entries are destroyed only after their protecting fences retire.
implementation.fallbacks: Copy-draw and uncached requests continue to use the prior allocation path.

assertions: After both in-flight slots are populated, later frames do not grow the cached draw-buffer count.
Cached asynchronous frame output is byte-identical to the prior expected readback.
Clearing the cache releases every cached draw-buffer entry.
regression.coverage_limit: Synthetic renderer fixture; it does not contain a captured retail Bink draw or prove game output.

host.ctest: 4/4 passed with VK_INSTANCE_LAYERS forced to Khronos validation.
host.renderer_test: Synthetic offscreen Vulkan 1.1 point and rectangle-list draws, depth/stencil SAMPLE_ZERO preservation, and captured sample-zero Copy/Convert passed with validation enabled.

android_arm64.device: Redmi Note 8 Pro (begonia), Mali-G76 MC4, Android 13/API 33, Vulkan 1.1.131.
android_arm64.result: The offscreen renderer regression passed on the device.
android_arm64.output: Synthetic offscreen Vulkan 1.1 AutoIndex point and rectangle-list draw plus 4x-to-1x depth/stencil SAMPLE_ZERO preservation and captured sample-zero Copy/Convert passed on Mali-G76 MC4.

live_game_state_after_check.observation: The retail process stayed on the legal disclaimer; the offscreen regression did not alter the game session.

limits: No end-to-end frame-time, throughput, or FPS benchmark was run for this cache change.
The tests are synthetic and do not validate a captured retail draw or full retail parity.
The game still has no new presenter submissions after its final 14-draw disclaimer batch; menu and race graphics remain unverified.
